title: Belle's Cheesy Potato Stoup
description: This soup is a yummy mix of potatoes, cheese, and SPAM®. I hope everyone who uses this recipe gets the same great review I do!!
ingredients: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of onion soup
1 (12 ounce) can fully cooked luncheon meat (such as SPAM®), cubed
1 pinch red pepper flakes, or to taste

steps.text: Place the potatoes into a large saucepan and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until the potatoes are tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain off all but 2 cups of the water, then stir in the cream of onion soup, luncheon meat, milk, and Cheddar cheese. Return to a simmer over medium heat, and cook a few minutes until hot. Season to taste with red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
